2608.06713.title: MolBioKG: Grounding Out-of-Graph Molecules in Biomedical Knowledge Graphs via Multi-Resolution Structural Anchoring
2608.06713.paper_summary: Biomedical knowledge graphs (KGs) accelerate drug discovery, but standard pipelines assume query molecules already exist as graph entities, leaving unregistered molecules disconnected. We address this cold-start challenge, termed the out-of-graph molecule problem, by introducing MolBioKG. This two-layer system grounds unseen molecules in biomedical evidence via multi-resolution structural anchoring. It connects an index of 2.74 million molecules (represented by scaffolds, fragments, functional groups, and fingerprints) to a 9.6-million-edge KG. Given only a SMILES string, MolBioKG retrieves structurally related graph entities and traverses their biomedical neighborhoods without task-specific training. It features two inference mechanisms: static multi-anchor retrieval using Reciprocal Rank Fusion, and Adapt-KG, a tool-using LLM policy for adaptive traversal. Evaluated across in-graph link recovery, complex multi-hop reasoning, and out-of-graph generalization, MolBioKG outperforms strong baselines. Notably, it raises Hits@10 from 0.585 to 0.876 in multi-hop reasoning and out-of-graph target recall from 0.145 to 0.269, all while ensuring predictions retain traceable structural anchors and source-attributed KG evidence.
2608.06713.paper_summary_zh: 生物醫學知識圖譜（KGs）加速了藥物發現，但標準流程假設查詢分子已作為圖形實體存在，這使得未註冊的分子無法連接。我們通過引入MolBioKG來解決這一冷啟動挑戰，稱為圖外分子問題。這個兩層系統通過多解析度結構錨定將未見分子與生物醫學證據相連接。它將274萬個分子的索引（由支架、片段、功能組和指紋表示）連接到一個960萬邊的KG。僅根據一個SMILES字符串，MolBioKG就能檢索結構相關的圖形實體，並在不需要特定任務訓練的情況下遍歷它們的生物醫學鄰域。它具有兩種推理機制：使用互惠排名融合的靜態多錨檢索，以及Adapt-KG，一種用於自適應遍歷的工具使用LLM策略。在圖內鏈接恢復、複雜多跳推理和圖外泛化的評估中，MolBioKG超越了強基準。值得注意的是，它在多跳推理中的Hits@10從0.585提高到0.876，圖外目標召回率從0.145提高到0.269，同時確保預測保留可追溯的結構錨和來源歸屬的KG證據。
